hadi-march/ui#model.name: model
hadi-march/ui#model.doc: Two-way value model for a control. Works with `bind:value` (getter `value` + `setValue`), a signal passed as `value`, a live `value` getter + `onChange`, or an uncontrolled initial `value`. Returns [get, set]; `set` also calls onChange(v).
hadi-march/ui#model.signature: function model<T>(props: object, def: T, name: string = "value"): [get: () => T, set: (v: T) => void]
hadi-march/ui#model.tr: Bir denetim için çift yönlü değer modeli. `bind:value` (getter `value` + `setValue`), `value` olarak verilen sinyal, canlı `value` getter'ı + `onChange` ya da denetimsiz başlangıç `value` ile çalışır. [get, set] döndürür.

hadi-march/ui#MoneyInput.name: MoneyInput
hadi-march/ui#MoneyInput.doc: Money: NumberInput with the currency symbol on the locale's side and the currency's decimals (2 for most). Props: currency.

props.name: currency
props.doc: ISO 4217 code (default "USD").

props.name: step
props.doc: ArrowUp / ArrowDown step (display units).

props.name: scale
props.doc: Display = value × scale.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: autofocus
props.doc: Focus this field when it appears.

hadi-march/ui#MoneyInput.tr: Para: para birimi simgesi dilin tarafında ve para biriminin ondalıklarıyla (çoğunda 2) NumberInput. Prop'lar: currency.

hadi-march/ui#MultiSelect.name: MultiSelect
hadi-march/ui#MultiSelect.doc: Multiple choice with chips; same props as Combobox (static options or async search). Value: array.
hadi-march/ui#MultiSelect.tr: Çipli çoklu seçim; Combobox ile aynı prop'lar (statik seçenekler ya da eşzamansız arama). Değer: dizi.

hadi-march/ui#NavMenu.name: NavMenu
hadi-march/ui#NavMenu.doc: items: [{ id, title, href, icon?, group?, badge?: () => number, keywords?, can?, hidden? }]

props.name: items
props.type: MaybeFn<readonly (NavItem | null | undefined | false)[] | null | undefined>

props.name: storageKey
props.doc: localStorage key for pins, recents and collapsed groups (default "hm.nav").

props.name: filter
props.doc: false: no filter box.

props.name: palette
props.doc: false: do not register the pages with the command palette.

props.name: collapsible
props.doc: Show a button that collapses the sidebar to an icon rail (state persists).

props.name: groupsCollapsed
props.doc: Groups start collapsed; the group of the active page opens itself.

props.name: groupIcons
props.doc: Icons for group headings (also the default icon of the group's items): `{ "Billing": wallet }`.

props.name: pins
props.doc: The pin (star) button of every item and the Pinned block (default true).

props.name: icons
props.type: { menu?: unknown; pin?: unknown; pinned?: unknown; chevron?: unknown; search?: unknown; rail?: unknown } | undefined
props.doc: Own icons for the built-in parts (an IconDef, a short string or a node): the menu button, the pin star (off / on), the group chevron, the filter's search icon and the rail button. `chevron: false` / `search: false` drop that mark.

props.name: labels
props.type: { filter?: MaybeFn<string>; filterPlaceholder?: MaybeFn<string>; noMatches?: MaybeFn<string>; pinned?: MaybeFn<string>; recent?: MaybeFn<string>; menu?: MaybeFn<string>; expandSidebar?: MaybeFn<string>; collapseSidebar?: MaybeFn<string>; pin?: (title: string) => string; unpin?: (title: string) => string; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts (strings or accessors); defaults are the translated ones. `pin` / `unpin` name an item's pin button.

hadi-march/ui#NavMenu.tr: items: [{ id, title, href, icon?, group?, badge?: () => number, keywords?, can?, hidden? }]

hadi-march/ui#NavSidebar.name: NavSidebar
hadi-march/ui#NavSidebar.doc: Side menu: groups, search, recent and featured items, collapsible rail, resizable width, remembered state.

props.name: items
props.type: MaybeFn<readonly (NavSidebarItem | null | undefined | false)[] | null | undefined>

props.name: title
props.doc: App name (bold) or any node; optional second line.

props.name: featured
props.doc: Highlighted items at the top (e.g. a support inbox with a live count).

props.name: recent
props.doc: How many recent visits to show (default 5, 0 = off).

props.name: groupOrder
props.doc: Category order: "alpha" (default, locale collation), "none" (as given) or explicit names first.

props.name: itemOrder
props.doc: Item order inside a category: "alpha" (default) or "none".

props.name: groupIcons
props.doc: Icons next to category names (and the default icon of their items).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: Categories open on first visit: "active" (only the one with the current page, default), "all" or "none".

props.name: hotkey
props.doc: Ctrl+K: focuses this search box ("focus", default) or belongs to a <CommandPalette> on the page ("palette": only the hint is shown here, the palette opens); false = no shortcut and no hint.

props.name: collapsible
props.doc: Collapse to an icon rail (button in the header; state persists).

props.name: storageKey
props.doc: localStorage key (default "hm.sidebar").

props.name: width
props.doc: Starting width: px (number) or a CSS length ("18rem"). Default 17.5rem.

props.name: resizable
props.doc: A grip on the inner edge changes the width (drag, touch, ← → Home End on the focused grip, double click resets).

props.name: minWidth
props.doc: Narrowest / widest width the grip allows, px (default 200 / 480).

props.name: onResize
props.doc: Called with the new width in px while resizing (and once it ends).

props.name: persist
props.doc: Remember the width (default true when resizable): in the sidebar's storage, or under this localStorage key.

props.name: collapseBelow
props.doc: Dragging narrower than this (px) switches to the icon rail; dragging wider again restores the labels.

props.name: palette
props.doc: false: do not register the items with the command palette.

props.name: search
props.doc: The search box (default true); false also drops its shortcut.

props.name: headings
props.doc: The "Recent" and "Categories" headings (default true); false also drops the expand / collapse all button.

props.name: expandAll
props.doc: The "Expand all" / "Collapse all" button beside the Categories heading (default true).

props.name: groupCounts
props.doc: The item count beside each category name (default true).

props.name: nestedSubs
props.doc: Nested items (a page under a page) also show their `sub` line (default false: only the label).

props.name: labels
props.type: { search?: MaybeFn<string>; clearSearch?: MaybeFn<string>; noMatches?: MaybeFn<string>; results?: MaybeFn<string>; recent?: MaybeFn<string>; categories?: MaybeFn<string>; expandAll?: MaybeFn<string>; collapseAll?: MaybeFn<string>; menu?: MaybeFn<string>; expandSidebar?: MaybeFn<string>; collapseSidebar?: MaybeFn<string>; resize?: MaybeFn<string>; showUnder?: (label: string) => string; hideUnder?: (label: string) => string; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts (strings or accessors); defaults are the translated ones. `showUnder` / `hideUnder` name the fold button of a parent item.

hadi-march/ui#NavSidebar.tr: Yan menü: gruplar, arama, son ve öne çıkan öğeler, daraltılabilir ray, yeniden boyutlandırılabilir genişlik, hatırlanan durum.

hadi-march/ui#normalizePhone.name: normalizePhone
hadi-march/ui#normalizePhone.doc: Normalize a typed phone number to "+" and digits; `country` ("+90") is prepended to national numbers.
hadi-march/ui#normalizePhone.signature: function normalizePhone(raw: unknown, country?: string | null): string
hadi-march/ui#normalizePhone.tr: Yazılan telefon numarasını "+" ve rakamlara çevirir; `country` ("+90") ulusal numaraların başına eklenir.

hadi-march/ui#NumberInput.name: NumberInput
hadi-march/ui#NumberInput.doc: Locale aware number: accepts "12,5" and "12.5", never produces NaN (bad text marks the input invalid and is reverted on blur). Props: min, max, step (ArrowUp/Down), decimals, minDecimals, grouping, scale (display = value × scale), locale, prefix, suffix.

props.name: step
props.doc: ArrowUp / ArrowDown step (display units).

props.name: scale
props.doc: Display = value × scale.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: autofocus
props.doc: Focus this field when it appears.

hadi-march/ui#NumberInput.tr: Dile duyarlı sayı: "12,5" ve "12.5" kabul eder, asla NaN üretmez (hatalı metin girdiyi geçersiz işaretler ve odak kaybında geri alınır). Prop'lar: min, max, step (ArrowUp/Down), decimals, minDecimals, grouping, scale ve diğerleri.

hadi-march/ui#openDialog.name: openDialog
hadi-march/ui#openDialog.doc: Open a dialog imperatively. `render(close)` returns the content; `close(value)` resolves the promise. Resolves `dismissValue` (default undefined) when dismissed.
hadi-march/ui#openDialog.signature:
function openDialog<T>(render: (close: (value: T) => void) => unknown, opts: DialogOptions<T> & { dismissValue: T }): Promise<T>
function openDialog<T = unknown>(render: (close: (value?: T) => void) => unknown, opts?: DialogOptions<T | undefined>): Promise<T | undefined>
hadi-march/ui#openDialog.tr: Bir iletişim kutusunu komutla açar. `render(close)` içeriği döndürür; `close(value)` sözü çözer. Kapatılırsa `dismissValue` (varsayılan undefined) ile çözülür.

hadi-march/ui#openDrawer.name: openDrawer
hadi-march/ui#openDrawer.doc: Open a side sheet imperatively (same contract as openDialog).
hadi-march/ui#openDrawer.signature:
function openDrawer<T>(render: (close: (value: T) => void) => unknown, opts: DialogOptions<T> & { dismissValue: T }): Promise<T>
function openDrawer<T = unknown>(render: (close: (value?: T) => void) => unknown, opts?: DialogOptions<T | undefined>): Promise<T | undefined>
hadi-march/ui#openDrawer.tr: Yan paneli komutla açar (openDialog ile aynı sözleşme).

hadi-march/ui#openMedia.name: openMedia
hadi-march/ui#openMedia.doc: Open media in a dialog. Options: `title`, `kind` ("auto" by default), `alt`, `poster`, `size` ("lg"), `autoplay`, `fallback`.
hadi-march/ui#openMedia.signature: function openMedia(src: string, o: OpenMediaOptions = {}): Promise<unknown>
hadi-march/ui#openMedia.tr: Medyayı bir iletişim kutusunda açar. Seçenekler: `title`, `kind` (varsayılan "auto"), `alt`, `poster`, `size` ("lg"), `autoplay`.

hadi-march/ui#openPalette.name: openPalette
hadi-march/ui#openPalette.doc: Open the command palette (mounts a default one if the app did not render <CommandPalette/>).
hadi-march/ui#openPalette.tr: Komut paletini açar (uygulama <CommandPalette/> çizmediyse varsayılan birini bağlar).

hadi-march/ui#OptionList.name: OptionList
hadi-march/ui#OptionList.doc: `<OptionList bind:value={$theme} label="Theme" options={[{ value: "light", label: "Light", icon: sun }, { value: "dark", label: "Dark", icon: moon }]} />`

props.name: value
props.type: Signal<T | null> | Signal<readonly T[]> | MaybeFn<T | readonly T[] | null | undefined>
props.doc: The chosen value (an array with `multiple`): a signal (two-way), a value / accessor, or `bind:value`.

props.name: onPick
props.type: ((value: T, item: OptionItem<T>, e: Event | null) => void) | undefined
props.doc: A row was chosen (click, Enter, Space).

props.name: multiple
props.doc: Several values can be chosen (listbox).

props.name: mode
props.doc: "radio" (default): one of many · "listbox": options, one or many · "menu": commands (checked when a value is given).

props.name: keysFrom
props.doc: The field whose keys drive the list (focus stays there; rows are highlighted through aria-activedescendant).

props.name: active
props.doc: The highlighted row with `keysFrom` (your own signal when you need to read or reset it).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the list.

props.name: check
props.doc: The tick on a chosen row: true (default), false, your own icon, or `() => node` (called for every row).

props.name: columns
props.doc: Rows per line (a grid of choices; default 1).

props.name: inline
props.doc: Hint beside the label instead of under it.

props.name: empty
props.doc: Shown when there are no options: text or a node (default "No results"); false for nothing.

props.name: renderOption
props.doc: Draw the inside of a row yourself.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme colour of the chosen row.

hadi-march/ui#OptionList.tr: Panel içinde seçenek listesi: radyo grubu, liste kutusu (tek / çoklu) ya da komut menüsü; ok tuşlarıyla ya da `keysFrom` ile bir alanın tuşlarıyla gezilir. `<OptionList bind:value={$tema} options={…} />`.

hadi-march/ui#OverflowText.name: OverflowText
hadi-march/ui#OverflowText.doc: `<OverflowText text="A very long title…" />` — scrolls on hover/focus only when clipped. `<OverflowText trigger="visible" mode="loop" text={news} />`, `<OverflowText trigger="always" mode="bounce">…</OverflowText>`.

props.name: text
props.doc: The text (or pass children).

props.name: trigger
props.doc: When to scroll (default hover + focus). "hover"/"focus" listen on the nearest link, button or list item.

props.name: mode
props.doc: bounce: to the end and back (default) · loop: endless ticker with a separator · once: to the end and back, one time.

props.name: speed
props.doc: Pixels per second (default 40).

props.name: pause
props.doc: Hold at each end, ms (default 1000).

props.name: delay
props.doc: Wait before starting after the trigger, ms (default 250).

props.name: separator
props.doc: Loop separator: text or a node (default "•"); false puts nothing between the copies.

props.name: easing
props.doc: Easing of each travel in bounce / once (default "ease-in-out"); the loop is always linear.

props.name: duplicate
props.doc: An endless strip (logos, quotes): the content is repeated so the strip is wider than its box and always loops. `true`: as many copies as fill the width (at least one); a number: that many copies. Copies are hidden from assistive technology and inert; each unit is a `.hm-marquee-unit`.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Never scroll (the text stays clipped with its fade or ellipsis): `disabled={() => !settings.motion}`.

props.name: fade
props.doc: Fade the clipped edges (default true); false shows an ellipsis instead.

props.name: play
props.doc: Extra condition that keeps it scrolling (e.g. the selected item of a menu): `play={() => isActive()}`.

props.name: host
props.doc: Element whose hover/focus starts it (default: closest a, button, li, label, [tabindex] — or itself).

hadi-march/ui#OverflowText.tr: `<OverflowText text="A very long title…" />` — yalnızca kırpıldığında üzerine gelince/odaklanınca kayar. `<OverflowText trigger="visible" mode="loop" text={news} />`, `<OverflowText trigger="always" mode="bounce">…</OverflowText>`.

hadi-march/ui#OverflowToolbar.name: OverflowToolbar
hadi-march/ui#OverflowToolbar.doc: `<OverflowToolbar label="Editor" items={[{ id: "save", command: "doc.save", priority: 10 }, { id: "s", separator: true }, …]} />`

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name.

props.name: end
props.doc: Content after the items that never overflows (a search field, a status).

props.name: moreLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the More button and its menu (default: "More actions", translated).

props.name: moreIcon
props.doc: Icon of the More button (default: three dots): your own node / icon.

props.name: tooltips
props.doc: Tooltips of icon-only buttons (default true); false: none (the buttons keep their accessible names).

props.name: motion
props.doc: How an item comes back from the More menu: "pop" (default), "fade", "none" / false, or `(el) => …` (your own animation).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token of pressed toggles and the focus ring (default: the theme's primary).

hadi-march/ui#OverflowToolbar.tr: `<OverflowToolbar label="Editor" items={[{ id: "save", command: "doc.save", priority: 10 }, { id: "s", separator: true }, …]} />` — sığmayan öğeleri taşma menüsüne alan araç çubuğu.

hadi-march/ui#Overlay.name: Overlay
hadi-march/ui#Overlay.doc:
`
…content…
` ` …} animate />`, `} opacity={0.3} />`

props.name: src
props.doc: Image or video URL (type from the extension, or `type`).

props.name: poster
props.doc: Video poster (also shown instead of the video on save-data / reduced motion).

props.name: alt
props.doc: A meaningful description; without it the overlay is decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: svg
props.doc: Inline SVG (an element or a component result).

props.name: draw
props.doc: Draw on a canvas sized to the container (devicePixelRatio aware).

props.name: animate
props.doc: Redraw every frame (paused while not visible and with reduced motion).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color of the effect (spotlight, dots, grid, vignette) and of an inline SVG's `currentColor`.

props.name: position
props.doc: object-position ("center", "50% 20%").

props.name: start
props.doc: Logical edges (RTL aware).

props.name: blend
props.doc: mix-blend-mode

props.name: front
props.doc: Above the container's content (glass, foreground effects). Default: behind it.

props.name: layer
props.doc: Explicit order instead of insertion order.

props.name: interactive
props.doc: Rarely needed: let the overlay take pointer input.

hadi-march/ui#Overlay.tr: Kartın arkasına/önüne video, efekt, canvas çizimi ya da SVG yerleştiren katman: `<Overlay src="/bg.webm" poster="/bg.jpg" />`, `<Overlay effect="glass" front />`, `<Overlay draw={(ctx, { width, height, time, theme }) => …} animate />`.

hadi-march/ui#OverlayScope.name: OverlayScope
hadi-march/ui#OverlayScope.doc: A box that keeps the layers opened inside it (drawers, dialogs, menus, toasts) inside it.
hadi-march/ui#OverlayScope.tr: İçinde açılan katmanları (çekmece, pencere, menü, bildirim) kendi içinde tutan kutu: önizlemeler, cihaz çerçeveleri, paneller.

hadi-march/ui#OverlayScopeContext.name: OverlayScopeContext
hadi-march/ui#OverlayScopeContext.doc: The overlay scope around this code (an <OverlayScope>).
hadi-march/ui#OverlayScopeContext.tr: Bir OverlayScope'un öğesini içindeki bileşenlere ileten bağlam.

hadi-march/ui#overlayScopeFor.name: overlayScopeFor
hadi-march/ui#overlayScopeFor.doc: The scope a layer opened now belongs in: the <OverlayScope> around the calling component, else the one around `from` (or the focused element: a click handler runs outside any component), else the page (null).
hadi-march/ui#overlayScopeFor.signature: function overlayScopeFor(from?: Element | null): HTMLElement | null
hadi-march/ui#overlayScopeFor.tr: Şimdi açılan bir katmanın ait olduğu kapsam: bileşenin bağlamından ya da odaklı öğeden bulunur.

hadi-march/ui#Page.name: Page
hadi-march/ui#Page.doc: `<Page title="Users" subtitle="…" actions={[invite, exportCsv]} breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Admin", href: "/admin" }]} back="/users" tabs={[…]} tabsQuery="tab">…</Page>` `back`: a path (Link) or `true` (history back). Actions render through ActionButton (hidden when not allowed). A Page builds on Layout: under one it adds its `corners` content, `features` and `layout` region content to it (all leave with the page) and writes its title to the document; on its own it brings the default Layout first. `Page.extend({ narrow: true, tabsQuery: "tab" })` makes a page kind with its own defaults.

props.name: layout
props.doc: Region content of the surrounding Layout while this page is shown, e.g. `{ aside: <Filters/> }`.

props.name: documentTitle
props.doc: Write the title to the document (through the Layout's titleTemplate). Default true.

props.name: back
props.doc: A path (Link), `true` (history back) or a function.

props.name: tabsQuery
props.doc: Keep the active tab in this query parameter.

props.name: corners
props.doc: Content for the page corners, e.g. `{ "top-end": <Status/> }` (a node or a list each).

hadi-march/ui#Page.tr: `<Page title="Users" subtitle="…" actions={[invite, exportCsv]} breadcrumbs={[{ label: "Admin", href: "/admin" }]} back="/users" tabs={[…]} tabsQuery="tab">…</Page>` `back`: bir yol (Link) ya da `true` (geçmişte geri).

hadi-march/ui#PageDots.name: PageDots

props.name: count
props.doc: Number of pages.

props.name: value
props.doc: Current page, 0-based.

props.name: onChange
props.doc: Makes the dots buttons: called with the page a dot stands for.

props.name: labels
props.type: { group?: string | undefined; page?: ((n: number) => string) | undefined; status?: ((n: number, count: number) => string) | undefined } | undefined
props.doc: Own names: the group, a dot (`page(n)`, n from 1) and the position text of read-only dots.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme colour token of the current dot (default: the accent).

props.name: variant
props.doc: "pill" (default: the current dot is longer) or "dot" (same size, only the colour changes).

props.name: dot
props.doc: Own content of a dot: `(index, active) => content` (numbers, thumbnails).

props.name: decorative
props.doc: Read-only dots hidden from screen readers (the position is announced elsewhere).

hadi-march/ui#PageDots.tr: Sayfa başına bir nokta, etkin olan uzun ve renkli; `onChange` ile düğme olur: `<PageDots count={5} bind:value={$page} />`

hadi-march/ui#Pager.name: Pager
hadi-march/ui#Pager.doc: Pagination. Offset mode: `<Pager page={$page} total={n} size={20} onPage={(p) => $page = p} sizes={[20, 50]} onSize={…} />` (page is 1-based). Cursor mode: `<Pager hasPrev={…} hasNext={…} onPrev={…} onNext={…} />`.

props.name: page
props.doc: Offset mode: 1-based page.

props.name: setPage
props.doc: Set by `bind:page`.

props.name: hasPrev
props.doc: Cursor mode.

hadi-march/ui#Pager.tr: Sayfalama. Ofset kipi: `<Pager page={$page} total={n} size={20} onPage={(p) => $page = p} sizes={[20, 50]} onSize={…} />` (sayfa 1'den başlar). İmleç kipi: `<Pager hasPrev={…} hasNext={…} onPrev={…} onNext={…} />`.

hadi-march/ui#Pagination.name: Pagination
hadi-march/ui#Pagination.doc: Numbered pages with ellipses: `<Pagination bind:page={$page} pages={20} />` (1-based). `variant="simple"` draws only Previous / Next: with a page count (`pages`, or `total` + `size`) or in cursor mode (`hasPrev`, `hasNext`, `onPrev`, `onNext`).

props.name: page
props.doc: Current page, 1-based (not needed in cursor mode).

props.name: pages
props.doc: Page count; or give `total` (+ `size`) and it is worked out.

props.name: variant
props.doc: "numbers" (default): numbered pages with ellipses; "simple": Previous / Next only (the page count may be unknown).

props.name: total
props.doc: Row count: gives the page count (with `size`) and the "1–20 of 134" text of the simple variant.

props.name: size
props.doc: Rows per page (default 20).

props.name: sizes
props.doc: Simple variant: the choices of a "rows per page" select.

props.name: hasPrev
props.doc: Cursor mode (simple variant, no page count): whether there is a previous / next page.

props.name: onPrev
props.doc: Cursor mode: called instead of `onPage`.

props.name: info
props.doc: Simple variant: the "1–20 of 134" text (shown when `total` is given). false: none; a function: your own text.

props.name: status
props.type: boolean | ((page: number, pages: number) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: Simple variant: the "Page 2 of 7" text between the buttons (shown when the page count is known). false: none; a function: your own text.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the nav (default "Pagination").

props.name: labels
props.type: { previous?: MaybeFn<string | undefined>; next?: MaybeFn<string | undefined>; page?: ((n: number) => string) | undefined; sizes?: MaybeFn<string | undefined> } | undefined
props.doc: Accessible names: the Previous / Next buttons, `page(n)` for a page button (default: the number), the rows-per-page select.

props.name: controls
props.doc: The Previous / Next buttons (default true).

props.name: prev
props.doc: Content of the Previous button: an icon or a short text (default: a chevron; simple: a chevron and "Previous").

props.name: next
props.doc: Content of the Next button: an icon or a short text (default: a chevron; simple: "Next" and a chevron).

props.name: gap
props.doc: The mark where pages are left out: the dots (default), your own icon or short text, or false for none.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token of the current page (default: neutral).

hadi-march/ui#Pagination.tr: Üç noktalı numaralı sayfalar: `<Pagination bind:page={$page} pages={20} />` (1'den başlar).

hadi-march/ui#PaletteButton.name: PaletteButton
hadi-march/ui#PaletteButton.doc: A search-field-looking button that opens the command palette: `<PaletteButton label="Search…" />` (shows Ctrl+K / ⌘K).

props.name: icon
props.doc: The search icon: default, false (none), or your own (an icon of hadi-march/icons, text or a node).

props.name: kbd
props.doc: The shortcut hint (Ctrl+K / ⌘K) at the end. Default true.

hadi-march/ui#PaletteButton.tr: Komut paletini açan arama alanı görünümlü düğme: `<PaletteButton label="Search…" />` (Ctrl+K / ⌘K gösterir).

hadi-march/ui#PanelHeader.name: PanelHeader
hadi-march/ui#PanelHeader.doc: `<PanelHeader icon={cog} title="Settings" subtitle="Workspace" actions={<Button size="sm">Save</Button>} onClose={close} divider />`

props.name: as
props.doc: Root element: "header" (default), "footer" (the bar under a panel: rule above, sticks to the bottom) or "div".

props.name: lead
props.doc: Before everything: a back button, a status dot, a drag grip.

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon (IconDef, emoji, node) before the title.

props.name: titleAs
props.doc: Element of the title (default "h3"; "span" in a footer).

props.name: titleId
props.doc: Id of the title element (aria-labelledby of the panel).

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: Second line under the title.

props.name: meta
props.doc: Right after the title: a count, a badge, a status.

props.name: actions
props.doc: The end side: buttons, menus (nodes or an accessor).

props.name: onClose
props.doc: Shows the close button and runs on it.

props.name: close
props.doc: The close button: shown when `onClose` is given (default), false for none, or your own icon for it.

props.name: closeLabel
props.doc: Accessible name and tooltip of the close button (default "Close").

props.name: size
props.doc: Height and type size (default md).

props.name: sticky
props.doc: Stays at the top (the bottom for a footer) of the scrolling panel.

props.name: divider
props.doc: A rule between the bar and the content.

props.name: tone
props.doc: "muted": the tinted bar of editors and code blocks.

props.name: drag
props.doc: The bar is a drag handle: no text selection, touch gestures go to your handlers.

props.name: align
props.doc: Titles at the top of a tall bar (default: centred).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme colour of the icon.

props.name: ref
props.doc: Called with the root element (drag behaviors attach here).

props.name: children
props.doc: Free content between the titles and the actions (tabs, a search box).

hadi-march/ui#PanelHeader.tr: Panelin üst (ya da `as="footer"` ile alt) çubuğu: ikon, başlık, alt başlık, sayı, eylemler ve kapat düğmesi; sürükleme tutamacı olarak da kullanılır. `<PanelHeader title="Ayarlar" onClose={kapat} divider />`.

hadi-march/ui#parse.name: parse
hadi-march/ui#parse.doc: Any CSS color → RGBA (null when it does not parse). `hue` is kept for greys (they have none of their own).
hadi-march/ui#parse.tr: Herhangi bir CSS rengi → RGBA (ayrıştırılamazsa null). `hue`, griler için korunur (kendi tonları yoktur).

hadi-march/ui#parseArgs.name: parseArgs
hadi-march/ui#parseArgs.doc: Read words against a command's argument and option specs; throws a readable error for a wrong or missing value.
hadi-march/ui#parseArgs.signature: function parseArgs(words: readonly string[], args: readonly ArgSpec[] = [], options: Record<string, OptionSpec> = {}): Parsed
hadi-march/ui#parseArgs.tr: Sözcükleri komutun argüman ve seçenek tanımına göre okur; yanlış ya da eksik değerde okunur bir hata atar.

hadi-march/ui#parseBezier.name: parseBezier
hadi-march/ui#parseBezier.doc: Parse cubic-bezier(…) or an engine easing name with a cubic-bezier CSS form; null otherwise.
hadi-march/ui#parseBezier.tr: cubic-bezier(…) ya da cubic-bezier CSS biçimi olan bir motor yumuşatma adını ayrıştırır; aksi halde null.

hadi-march/ui#parseDate.name: parseDate
hadi-march/ui#parseDate.doc: Parse "2026-03-14" or a numeric date in the locale's order ("14.03.2026", "3/14/26"). null = empty, undefined = invalid.
hadi-march/ui#parseDate.signature: function parseDate(text: unknown, loc?: string): IsoDate | null | undefined
hadi-march/ui#parseDate.tr: "2026-03-14" ya da dilin sırasındaki sayısal bir tarihi ("14.03.2026", "3/14/26") ayrıştırır. null = boş, undefined = geçersiz.

hadi-march/ui#parseGradient.name: parseGradient
hadi-march/ui#parseGradient.doc: Parse a CSS gradient (the forms gradientCss writes and the common hand-written ones). Null when it is not one.
hadi-march/ui#parseGradient.tr: Bir CSS gradyanını ayrıştırır (gradientCss'in yazdığı biçimler ve yaygın elle yazılanlar). Gradyan değilse null.

hadi-march/ui#parseJson.name: parseJson
hadi-march/ui#parseJson.doc: Parse JSON; returns { value } or { error, line, column }.
hadi-march/ui#parseJson.tr: JSON'u ayrıştırır; { value } ya da { error, line, column } döndürür.

hadi-march/ui#parseKey.name: parseKey
hadi-march/ui#parseKey.doc: Parse "mod+shift+k" → { key, ctrl, meta, alt, shift }.
hadi-march/ui#parseKey.tr: "mod+shift+k" → { key, ctrl, meta, alt, shift } ayrıştırır.

hadi-march/ui#parseNumber.name: parseNumber
hadi-march/ui#parseNumber.doc: Parse a number typed by a person. Accepts decimal comma and decimal point, grouping, spaces and a leading sign. Returns null for empty input, NaN for garbage. Ambiguous "1.234" / "1,234" follows the locale.
hadi-march/ui#parseNumber.signature: function parseNumber(text: unknown, loc: string = untrack(locale)): number | null
hadi-march/ui#parseNumber.tr: Bir kişinin yazdığı sayıyı ayrıştırır. Ondalık virgül ve noktayı, gruplamayı, boşlukları ve baştaki işareti kabul eder. Boş girdi için null, anlamsız girdi için NaN döndürür. Belirsiz "1.234" / "1,234" dile göre yorumlanır.

hadi-march/ui#PasswordInput.name: PasswordInput
hadi-march/ui#PasswordInput.doc: Password with a show / hide toggle. `autocomplete` defaults to "current-password" (use "new-password" on sign-up).

props.name: toggle
props.doc: The show / hide button: `false` removes it; a function draws its content (`(shown) => <Icon of={shown ? eyeOff : eye} />`).

props.name: labels
props.type: { show?: unknown; hide?: unknown; showPassword?: string | undefined; hidePassword?: string | undefined } | undefined
props.doc: Texts: `show` / `hide` (the button text), `showPassword` / `hidePassword` (its accessible name).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: autofocus
props.doc: Focus this field when it appears.

hadi-march/ui#PasswordInput.tr: Göster / gizle düğmeli parola. `autocomplete` varsayılanı "current-password" (kayıt ekranında "new-password" kullanın).

hadi-march/ui#PercentInput.name: PercentInput
hadi-march/ui#PercentInput.doc: Percent: shows 12.5 % for a stored 0.125 (`fraction={false}` stores 12.5).

props.name: fraction
props.doc: `false` stores 12.5 for 12.5 % (default: 0.125).

props.name: step
props.doc: ArrowUp / ArrowDown step (display units).

props.name: scale
props.doc: Display = value × scale.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: autofocus
props.doc: Focus this field when it appears.

hadi-march/ui#PhoneInput.name: PhoneInput
hadi-march/ui#PhoneInput.doc: Phone number: keeps "+" and digits only. Props: country (e.g. "+44", shown as a prefix). Value: "+447700900123".

props.name: country
props.doc: Country calling code ("+44"), shown as a prefix and prepended to national numbers.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: autofocus
props.doc: Focus this field when it appears.

hadi-march/ui#PhoneInput.tr: Telefon numarası: yalnızca "+" ve rakamları tutar. Prop'lar: country (örn. "+44", önek olarak gösterilir). Değer: "+447700900123".

hadi-march/ui#pickerKind.name: pickerKind
hadi-march/ui#pickerKind.signature: function pickerKind(options: readonly Option[], kind: PickerKind | "auto" = "auto"): PickerKind

hadi-march/ui#pickMain.name: pickMain
hadi-march/ui#pickMain.doc: The main provider that `<Widget>` would draw for this input (exported for tests and tools).
hadi-march/ui#pickMain.signature:
function pickMain

(sources: readonly WidgetPoint

[], input: P): WidgetProvider

| undefined
hadi-march/ui#pickMain.tr: `<Widget>`'ın bu girdi için çizeceği ana sağlayıcı (test ve araçlar için dışa aktarılır).

hadi-march/ui#Picture.name: Picture
hadi-march/ui#Picture.doc: `<Picture source={project.cover} />`, `<Picture src="/hero.jpg" alt="…" width={1200} height={800} loading="eager" fit="cover" />`

props.name: source
props.doc: A picture object or a ready node (a node is returned as it is).

props.name: alt
props.doc: Alternative text ("" marks a decorative image).

props.name: loading
props.doc: "lazy" (default) or "eager": loads at once with high priority (the first screen).

props.name: fit
props.doc: How the image fills its box when it is sized by the parent: "cover", "contain". Default: its natural size, never wider than the box.

props.name: fallback
props.doc: Shown instead of the image when it fails to load: text or a node.

hadi-march/ui#Picture.tr: Resim nesnesini (`{ src, alt, width, height, srcset, sizes }`) tembel yüklenen bir `` olarak çizer, hazır düğümü olduğu gibi döndürür: ``

hadi-march/ui#place.name: place
hadi-march/ui#place.doc: Compute a fixed position for `panel` next to `anchor`.
hadi-march/ui#place.signature: function place(anchor: Element, panel: Element | null | undefined, placement: Placement = "bottom-start", gap: number = 6): PlacedStyle
hadi-march/ui#place.tr: `panel` için `anchor` yanında sabit bir konum hesaplar.

hadi-march/ui#pointer.name: pointer
hadi-march/ui#pointer.doc: "/a/0/b~1c" (RFC 6901 JSON pointer) for a path; "" is the root.
hadi-march/ui#pointer.tr: Bir yol için "/a/0/b~1c" (RFC 6901 JSON işaretçisi); "" kök demektir.
